# Parity report: Custody area vs legacy Portfolio Viewer (T027, SC-002)

**Verdict: PASS — 425 differences, all 425 explained by D1/D2/D3, 0 unexplained, 0 expected rules not observed.**

Run on 2026-11-09 against the live PV and a fresh database. Generated from `scripts/legacy-parity/report/report.json` (`npm run parity:compare`), which lists every diff.

## Method

1. **Legacy PV (real, running):** `.agents/skills/legacy-portfolio-viewer/pv-up.sh` started Portfolio Viewer v3.2.1 (build 2018.11) on `http://localhost:8080` (Mono xsp4 + SQL Server 2022, `PORTFOLIOVIEWER` restored from the legacy repo's seed, archive `C:\Custody\Archive` mounted read-only). The legacy repo was not modified.
2. **Fresh golden:** `npm run parity:capture -- --out <scratch>` drove PV's pages (Login, Client Search/Summary, Holdings, Settlements, Position Check, Check All, Admin) as `PVADMIN`. The fresh `manifest.json` and `pv-golden.json.gz` are **byte-identical** to the committed `scripts/legacy-parity/golden/` (sha256 `05d07685d9c01310…`), so the committed snapshot is a faithful capture of the running PV.
3. **New system:** `npm run db:setup` (fresh schema, synthetic reference data, full archive load), API on `:3001` with `ENABLE_TEST_RESET=1`.
4. **Compare:** `npm run parity:compare` requests the same keys from `/api/custody`, keys rows (holdings/breaks by ISIN, settlements by SEME, check-all by acctId, clients by clientId), compares numbers within ±0.005 (PV 2 dp display), strips leading zeros on safe codes, and classifies each diff against `scripts/legacy-parity/expected-divergences.json`. Any unmatched diff fails the run.
5. **Browser spot-check:** `e2e/custody/parity-spotcheck.spec.ts` (part of `npm run test:e2e:custody`) reads the PV golden and asserts the Custody UI shows the same holdings lines/totals and break rows for accounts 2001, 2038, 2074, 2125 (safe 10554), 2129 (safe 11397) and 2145 (01079-03), and the D1/D2/D3 deltas below. The same screens were also compared side by side with PV in the T028 recording.
